scripts.build: turbo run build && bun run perf:check && bun run native:smoke
scripts.test: turbo run test && bun test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.perf:browser: playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "home scene meets runtime performance gates" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "work scene meets runtime performance gates" && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --grep "room designer loads compressed interior props"
scripts.test:e2e: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium && bunx turbo run build --filter=@agent-hq/web^... && bun run perf:browser
scripts.perf:gate: bun run build && bun run perf:browser && bun run perf:check:runtime
